import sys, random, collections
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import planner
from gen2 import gen_case
rng = random.Random(0)
case = gen_case(rng, 512, 256, 32, 16)
rounds=[];imps=[]
orig_a=planner._block_a
def a(net,cap):
    rounds[-1]+=1
    return orig_a(net,cap)
planner._block_a=a
orig_d=planner._dijkstra
def d(net,cap):
    rounds.append(0); imps.append([])
    return orig_d(net,cap)
planner._dijkstra=d
orig_b=planner._block_b
def b(net,cap):
    before=list(net.wdist)
    r=orig_b(net,cap)
    imps[-1].append(sum(1 for x,y in zip(before,net.wdist) if y<x))
    return r
planner._block_b=b
res=planner.solve_epoch(case)
slow=[(r,imps[i]) for i,r in enumerate(rounds) if r>=24]
print('num slow',len(slow))
print('sample', slow[:4])
print('lengths', collections.Counter(len(s[1]) for s in slow).most_common(5))
print('first-impr distribution', collections.Counter(s[1][0] for s in slow).most_common(5))
print('later', collections.Counter(sum(s[1][1:]) for s in slow).most_common(5))
